bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the probability assigned to social stereotypical attributes for specific groups (using data from StereoSet). The method evaluates whether the model limits the probability of generating the stereotypical continuation to below a predefined threshold (e.g., 0.1%).

Comparing the log-likelihoods of male and female pronouns ('he' versus 'she') in contexts describing specific careers (adapted from WinoBias). The evaluation checks if the absolute difference in log-likelihoods between the pronouns falls within a balanced threshold limit.
